products.title: 14K Gold North Star Bracelet, Lab Grown Sapphire, Eight Pointed Star, Christmas Gift
products.description:
A single eight-pointed North Star in 14k gold on a fine Franco chain, with one lab grown white sapphire flush set at its centre. It works as a Christmas gift and keeps its meaning all year: a guiding star for a new job, a move or a graduation.

THE PIECE
One flat star, 11.0 mm tip to tip and 1.1 mm thick, with eight straight arms of equal length. Each arm carries a low centre ridge with two polished facets and ends in a rounded 1.0 mm tip, so nothing catches on knitwear. A raised round hub 3.4 mm wide sits at the centre. The two arms that point along the chain carry the chain rings, so the star sits face up. Franco chain 1.5 mm on both sides, high polish.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.45 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.45 g in total with the stone. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

STONES
One 1.5 mm round lab grown white sapphire, about 0.017 ct, flush set in the hub so its table sits level with the gold. A small hole under the stone lets light in and keeps the setting clean.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The star, its hub and both chain rings are cast in 14k gold as one piece, then filed, faceted and polished. There is no solder in the station; every join made at the bench is closed with a laser weld. The stone setting is cut and the stone is set after polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth after wearing. Take it off before swimming and keep it away from chlorine and household chemicals. Warm soapy water and a soft brush will clean the chain and the setting.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.

products.title: 14K Gold Icicle Fringe Bracelet, Seven Solid Gold Drops, Winter Christmas Gift for Her
products.description:
Seven solid 14k gold icicles hang from the centre of a fine cable chain, graded from 8 mm at the ends to 12 mm in the middle. A winter Christmas gift that moves with the wrist and still looks right in spring as a simple gold fringe.

THE PIECE
Seven solid tapered drops, 8, 9, 10, 12, 10, 9 and 8 mm long, spaced 3.0 mm centre to centre for a fringe about 20 mm wide. Each drop is 2.2 mm wide at the top and narrows to a rounded 0.8 mm tip, with a shallow spiral line on its upper part and a high polish. Each one hangs from its own small gold loop on a 1.2 mm cable chain and swings freely.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.37 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.37 g in total. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each icicle is cast in 14k gold in one piece with its loop, then polished and given its spiral line. There is no solder: each loop is closed around its chain link with a laser weld, and so is every other join made at the bench.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth after wearing. Take it off before swimming and keep it away from chlorine and household chemicals. Warm soapy water and a soft brush will clean the chain and the setting.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.

products.title: 14K Gold Comet Bracelet, Ice Blue Enamel, Lab Grown Sapphire, Cuban Chain, Celestial Gift
products.description:
One 14k gold comet on a 2.0 mm Miami Cuban chain, its tail inlaid with opaque ice-blue glass enamel and its head set with two lab grown white sapphires. A Christmas gift with a sky theme rather than a holiday one, so it is worn long after the season.

THE PIECE
One station 19 mm long with a slight arch along its length. The head is 5.0 mm wide; its front half is a flat platform 1.6 mm thick that holds the stones. The tail narrows from 3.0 mm at the head to 1.2 mm at the rounded tip. An enamel channel runs along the first 11 mm of the tail inside 0.7 mm gold walls, and the last 3 mm is plain polished gold. Miami Cuban chain 2.0 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.29 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.31 g in total with the enamel and stones. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice-blue. It fills one narrowing channel along the comet tail. The enamel surface sits 0.1 mm below the gold edge, so the gold takes knocks first. Fired glass is hard but can chip under a sharp knock, so take the bracelet off for the gym and the pool, keep it away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

STONES
Two 1.5 mm round lab grown white sapphires, about 0.034 ct together, flush set side by side at the front of the head, level with the gold. Each sits over a small hole that lets light in and keeps the setting clean.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The station is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece with its chain rings, and the enamel cells are formed in the casting itself. There is no solder in the station: the enamel is fired three times, and every join is closed afterwards with a laser weld away from the enamel. The stones are set last, after the final firing.

CARE
Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. Store the bracelet on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
products.cold_enamel_paragraph:
ENAMEL
The colour on this piece is hand-applied cold enamel (coloured epoxy resin), not kiln-fired glass: opaque ice-blue, set into the narrowing channel along the comet tail. Resin is softer than glass and can scratch with wear. Avoid ultrasonic and steam cleaning and solvents, keep it away from chlorine, and clean it with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

products.title: 14K Gold Hamsa Bracelet, Lab Grown Blue Sapphire Eye, Franco Chain, Protection Gift
products.description:
A 14k gold hamsa hand with a pale ice-blue lab grown sapphire set as the eye in its palm, on a fine Franco chain. A Christmas gift that carries straight into the new year as an everyday protection charm.

THE PIECE
One flat hamsa 10.0 mm wide, 12.0 mm tall and 1.0 mm thick, with three upright fingers, two outward-curving thumbs and a polished bevelled edge. All tips are fully rounded. In the palm a raised gold almond outline 6.5 mm wide frames a small domed boss that holds the stone. The chain attaches at the two thumb tips so the hand sits upright. Franco chain 1.3 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.53 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.54 g in total with the stone. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

STONES
One 2.0 mm round lab grown sapphire in a pale ice-blue tone, about 0.034 ct, flush set in the boss so its table sits level with the gold. A small hole under the stone lets light in and keeps the setting clean.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The hamsa, its eye outline, the stone boss and both chain rings are cast in 14k gold as one piece, then bevelled and polished. There is no solder in the station; every join made at the bench is closed with a laser weld. The stone setting is cut and the stone is set after polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth after wearing. Take it off before swimming and keep it away from chlorine and household chemicals. Warm soapy water and a soft brush will clean the chain and the setting.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.

products.description:
A small 14k gold snaffle bit with a working jointed mouthpiece, its two D cheek pieces inlaid with deep jade-green glass enamel. A Christmas gift for a rider that reads as classic equestrian gold the rest of the year.

THE PIECE
One station 22 mm long. Two flat D-shaped cheek pieces, each 7.5 mm tall, 5.0 mm deep and 1.4 mm thick with a 1.8 mm round hole, are joined by a two-part mouthpiece of 1.5 mm round bars that link through two interlocking loops and move at the centre. Each D carries one curved enamel channel 7.5 mm long and 0.75 mm wide inside 0.7 mm gold walls. Miami Cuban chain 1.8 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.69 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.70 g in total with the enamel. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep jade-green. It fills one curved channel on each cheek piece; the moving joint carries no enamel. The enamel surface sits 0.1 mm below the gold edge, so the gold takes knocks first. Fired glass is hard but can chip under a sharp knock, so take the bracelet off for the gym and the pool, keep it away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The station is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in two halves, each cheek piece in one piece with its half of the mouthpiece and its chain ring, and the enamel cells are formed in the casting itself. There is no solder in the station: the enamel is fired three times, and every join is closed afterwards with a laser weld away from the enamel.

CARE
Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. Store the bracelet on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
products.cold_enamel_paragraph:
ENAMEL
The colour on this piece is hand-applied cold enamel (coloured epoxy resin), not kiln-fired glass: opaque deep jade-green, set into one curved channel on each D cheek piece. Resin is softer than glass and can scratch with wear. Avoid ultrasonic and steam cleaning and solvents, keep it away from chlorine, and clean it with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

products.title: 14K Gold Stirrup Bracelet, Three Lab Grown Sapphires, Franco Chain, Equestrian Gift for Her
products.description:
Three small 14k gold stirrups on a fine Franco chain, each with one lab grown white sapphire flush set in its base. A Christmas gift for a rider, and a quiet equestrian piece for every season after it.

THE PIECE
Three flat stations about 13 mm apart: a centre stirrup 8.5 mm tall and two side stirrups 6.5 mm tall. Each is a rounded open arch of diamond-cut gold, 1.3 by 1.1 mm in section, on a flat base bar 1.0 mm thick, with the inner arch mirror-polished. A raised square pad 2.4 mm wide in the middle of each base bar holds the stone. Franco chain 1.3 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.64 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.65 g in total with the stones. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

STONES
Three 1.5 mm round lab grown white sapphires, about 0.051 ct together, one flush set in each stirrup base so its table sits level with the gold. A small hole under each stone lets light in and keeps the setting clean.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each stirrup is cast in 14k gold as one piece with its pad and both chain rings, then diamond-cut and polished. There is no solder in the stations; every join made at the bench is closed with a laser weld. The stone settings are cut and the stones are set after polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth after wearing. Take it off before swimming and keep it away from chlorine and household chemicals. Warm soapy water and a soft brush will clean the chain and the setting.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

products.title: 14K Gold Cardinal Bracelet, Berry Enamel Bird, Lab Grown Sapphire Eye, Memorial Gift
products.description:
A small 14k gold cardinal in profile, its breast inlaid with deep berry glass enamel and a lab grown white sapphire set as its eye. Often chosen as a Christmas gift, the cardinal is also a remembrance bird, which keeps it meaningful all year.

THE PIECE
One flat bird 10.5 mm long, 8.5 mm tall and 1.4 mm thick, with an upright crest, a short beak and a raised tail, all with rounded tips. The body and wing are smooth polished gold, with two small open cut-outs behind the wing and under the tail. The breast is a single enamel field inside a 0.7 mm gold rim. Franco chain 1.5 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.52 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.54 g in total with the enamel and stone. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep berry (dark purple-red). It fills the single breast cell. The enamel surface sits 0.1 mm below the gold edge, so the gold takes knocks first. Fired glass is hard but can chip under a sharp knock, so take the bracelet off for the gym and the pool, keep it away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

STONES
One 1.5 mm round lab grown white sapphire, about 0.017 ct, flush set as the eye, level with the gold and 1.2 mm away from the enamel. A small hole behind the stone lets light in.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The station is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece with its chain rings, and the enamel cells are formed in the casting itself. There is no solder in the station: the enamel is fired three times, and every join is closed afterwards with a laser weld away from the enamel. The stone is set last, after the final firing.

CARE
Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. Store the bracelet on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.

The colour on this piece is hand-applied cold enamel (coloured epoxy resin), not kiln-fired glass: opaque deep berry (dark purple-red), set into the breast of the cardinal. products.description:
A stylised 14k gold scarab with deep jade-green glass enamel wing cases, on a 2.0 mm Miami Cuban chain. The scarab is an old amulet of renewal, so a Christmas gift of it carries naturally into the new year.

THE PIECE
One station 11.0 mm long and 8.0 mm wide including its six legs, with a body 6.4 mm wide and a solid domed back 1.6 mm high. Two enamel wing cases sit either side of a 0.7 mm gold centre line. The front gold shield has five fan-shaped open slits and a row of six raised dots. The underside is flat polished gold. Miami Cuban chain 2.0 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.41 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.43 g in total with the enamel. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep jade-green. It fills the two wing-case cells and follows the curve of the dome. The enamel surface sits 0.1 mm below the gold edge, so the gold takes knocks first. Fired glass is hard but can chip under a sharp knock, so take the bracelet off for the gym and the pool, keep it away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The station is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece with its chain rings, and the enamel cells are formed in the casting itself. There is no solder in the station: the enamel is fired three times, and every join is closed afterwards with a laser weld away from the enamel.

CARE
Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. Store the bracelet on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
products.cold_enamel_paragraph:
ENAMEL
The colour on this piece is hand-applied cold enamel (coloured epoxy resin), not kiln-fired glass: opaque deep jade-green, set into the two wing cases of the scarab. Resin is softer than glass and can scratch with wear. Avoid ultrasonic and steam cleaning and solvents, keep it away from chlorine, and clean it with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

ENAMEL
The colour is hand-applied cold enamel (coloured epoxy resin), not kiln-fired glass. It is set into cells cast into the gold, level with the surface. Resin can scratch with wear: avoid ultrasonic and steam cleaning, solvents and perfume on the coloured areas.

workshop.dimensions: Disk D9.2 x 1.35 (hucre 0.55 + taban 0.80). Hucreler: gozbebegi D1.8; beyaz halka r1.6-2.4 (0.8 gen); lacivert halka r3.1-3.9 (0.8 gen); hucre arasi ve cevre altin duvar 0.7. Hilal: dis daire R6.0 (merkez y=-1.0), ic daire R5.6 (merkez y=+1.8), t=1.0; diskle alt 130 derecelik yay boyunca kaynasik (0.8 bindirme); hilal-disk araligi uclarda >=0.6, daha darsa kati dolgu. Boynuz uclari D2.4 x 1.5 ped (merkez +/-6.45, 0.4). Boyun min kesit 1.0 x 1.0. Toplam 15.3 x 11.6 mm + arka kulp.
workshop.construction: Tek parca 14K cinkosuz alasim dokum: disk, hilal, iki ped, hucre duvarlari ve arka kulp ayni mumdan; lehim hic yok. Hucreler dokumde birakilir (oyma degil), tabanlar filetolu (r0.15). Disk arkasi ciplak altin (karsi-mine gerekmez: taban 0.80, L2). Mine 3 pisirim, taslar tum pisirimlerden sonra soguk.
bench_sequence: 1. CAD: bitmis olcu + 0.2 bitirme payi; hucre derinligi 0.55 (+0.05 tesviye payi), duvarlar 0.7 net (model 0.75), taban filetosu r0.15.
2. Recine baski, besleme disk alt-arkasindan (en kalin kesit), boynuzlara yardimci kanal.
3. Yatirim + yakma; CINKOSUZ 14K alasimla vakum dokum. Dokum sonrasi gozeneklilik kontrolu (10x lup, hucre tabanlari); gozenekli parca HURDA (mine pinhole verir).
4. Tesviye ve on cila (hilal, pedler); hucre ici: ince cam fircayla temizle, taban kalinligi 0.80 kumpas/derinlik saati ile.
5. Yuzey zenginlestirme (depletion gilding): 3-4 dongu ~593 C kiraz kirmizisi tav + %10 H2SO4 asit; damitik su, cam firca, yagsiz.
6. Mine dolumu: 80 mesh yikanmis opak beyaz ve lacivert, islak dolum; kurut (firin ustu 2-3 dk).
7. Pisirim 1: 780 C, 90 sn, paslanmaz sehpa (trivet), kalibre pirometre.
8. Pisirim 2: ikinci dolum, 780 C, 90 sn (yuzeyden hafif tasma).
9. Tasla zimpara (alundum cubuk + su) mine ve altin duvarlar es seviye; temizle.
10. Pisirim 3: 770 C, 60 sn parlatma pisirimi. Toplam 3 pisirim.
11. Asitleme YOK (mine korunur); sodyum bikarbonat + su ile notr temizlik.
12. Tas yuvalari (pedlerde): pilot delik teyidi, hart bur; mine Plasti-tac/bant ile maskelenir.
13. Tas oturtma soguk; itme kuvveti diskin tersine (disaridan iceri degil); mineye 1.45 mm mesafe.
14. Pisirim sonrasi lazer: YOK (kulp entegre dokum).
15. Cila: yalniz altin yuzeyler, elde, mineye dokunmadan; QC: pinhole/catlak lup 10x, tartim (uc 1.75 g +/- %5), boynuz uc kontrolu.
bom: Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi ve solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Bitmis uc 1.750 g x 1.15 = 2.01 g dokum metali.
Mine tozu: kursunsuz opak lacivert ~75 mg + opak beyaz ~40 mg (pisirilmis mine 42 mg; dolum/tas kaybi icin ~2.5x).

Bulgular: istakoz 0.25 g (tahmin), 2 atlama halkasi 0.060 g, etiket 0.046 g.

products.description:
An evil eye in navy and white glass enamel, held by a gold crescent that wraps its lower half, with a pale blue lab-grown sapphire at each tip. A protection gift for Christmas that is worn all year.

THE PIECE
15.3 mm across the crescent tips and 11.6 mm tall. The eye disc is 9.2 mm across, the crescent is polished gold and joined to the disc along its inner edge. The bail is hidden behind the disc.

GOLD WEIGHT
4.01 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 4.06 g in total with the enamel and stones.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque, in navy blue and white: three fields divided by 0.7 mm gold rings, level with the gold.

STONES

Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

products.description:
A cardinal in profile, its breast, wing and tail in deep berry glass enamel and its crest and face in polished gold. A keepsake many people give when they remember someone at Christmas.

THE PIECE
11 mm wide and 15 mm tall, 1.35 mm thick. The enamel is a dark blackberry red, divided into three fields by fine gold lines that mark the wing and tail. The eye is a small round opening through the gold. The bail is hidden behind the back.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.82 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.89 g in total with the enamel.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep berry, cadmium-free, level with the gold.

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.0 mm 14k cable chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.

products.title: 14K Gold North Star Stud Earrings, Lab Grown White Sapphire, Eight-Point Starburst
products.description:
An eight-pointed star in 14k gold, with a flush-set lab-grown white sapphire at the center of each stud. Bright faceted ridges run along every point, so the pair catches light at a small size, an easy Christmas gift that is worn all year.

THE PIECE
Each stud is an eight-pointed star: four long points 11.4 mm tip to tip and four short points 7.6 mm tip to tip. The center boss is 3.4 mm across and 1.8 mm thick. Every point has straight side walls 0.6 mm high and a low two-facet ridge, and ends in a rounded tip 0.8 mm wide. The back is flat polished gold.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.55 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.56 g in total with the stones. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

STONES
Two 2.0 mm round lab-grown white sapphires, one per stud, 0.068 ct in total. Each is flush set, table level with the gold, over a small hole that lets light and cleaning water through. The stones are set last, after all polishing.

LENGTH AND FIT
Each star measures 11.4 mm across the long points. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back. The post sits just above the center, so the star stays upright on the lobe.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each star is cast in 14k gold in one piece, then the ridges are cut bright and polished. There is no solder: the post is laser welded into a small socket, so it keeps its hardness. The sapphire is set cold, after the last polish.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap and a soft brush. Keep lotion out of the small hole behind the stone. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.

products.title: 14K Gold Hexagon Icicle Drop Earrings, Faceted Solid Gold Spike, Geometric Winter Dangle
products.description:
A six-sided icicle in solid 14k gold, hanging from a small hexagonal post top, with six long polished facets that flash as it moves. It is a clean geometric drop for winter, a natural Christmas gift that keeps working in every season.

THE PIECE
A flat hexagonal top, 3.4 mm across flats and 0.9 mm thick, sits on the lobe. From its lower edge a 1.0 mm gold ring holds the icicle by a small closed loop. The icicle is solid, 10.5 mm long, 2.2 mm across flats at the top and 0.8 mm at the rounded tip. Overall length about 17 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.68 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.68 g in total. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

LENGTH AND FIT
About 17 mm from the top of the hexagon to the tip of the icicle, so it hangs just below the lobe and swings freely on its ring. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The hexagon and the icicle are cast in 14k gold, the six facets are flattened and polished by hand, and the ring is closed with a 1.0 mm gold insert laser welded at both ends. There is no solder, and the post is laser welded, so it stays hard.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth; warm water and mild soap are fine. Take the earrings off before sleeping so the icicle does not catch on fabric. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

products.description:
A small gold crescent with a traditional evil eye hanging below it, enamelled in navy-blue, white and ice-blue glass. It is a protection charm in 14k gold, given as a Christmas gift and worn all year.

THE PIECE
A polished crescent, 4.8 mm wide and 3.2 mm tall with its points up, sits on the lobe. Below it a 1.0 mm gold ring holds a flat disc 5.4 mm across and 1.4 mm thick. The eye on the disc is 4.0 mm across, inside a 0.7 mm polished gold rim. Overall length about 12 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.69 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.73 g in total with the enamel. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque, in the traditional nazar order from the outside inward: a navy-blue ring, a white ring and an ice-blue ring, each 0.5 mm wide, and a navy-blue center dot 1.0 mm across. The colours are laid side by side in one cell and fired together, so each colour edge is soft by a fraction of a millimetre. The enamel sits level with the gold rim or just below it. Glass does not fade, but a hard knock can chip it: keep the earrings away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
About 12 mm long, sitting just below the lobe; the disc moves freely on its ring. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The crescent and the disc are cast separately in zinc-free 14k gold, and the enamel cell is formed in the casting itself. The enamel is fired four times at no more than 780 C. There is no solder: the post is laser welded to the crescent, which never goes into the kiln, and the ring is closed with a laser weld well away from the enamel.

CARE
Store the pair on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
products.cold_enamel_paragraph:
ENAMEL
The colour on this piece is hand-applied cold enamel (coloured epoxy resin), not kiln-fired glass: opaque navy-blue, white and ice-blue in the traditional nazar order from the outside inward: a navy-blue ring, a white ring, an ice-blue ring and a navy-blue center dot. Resin is softer than glass and can scratch with wear. Avoid ultrasonic and steam cleaning and solvents, keep it away from chlorine, and clean it with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

B disk Ø5.4 x 1.4; ustte dokum KAPALI goz 1.0 kesit, ic Ø1.2. Tek yuvarlak hucre Ø4.0, 0.6 derin, taban 0.8, jant 0.70 (arka pah 0.7 x 0.5, dis kenar 0.9). (B) nazar diski + kapali goz; tek champleve hucre DOKUMDE (oyma yok), taban duz, doku yok. Nazar geleneksel sirasi tek hucrede yan yana islak dolumla kurulur (renkler arasi altin duvar yok; 3 renk ayni yumusak seri, ayni sicaklik). B 4 pisirimle bitirilir. Montaj: C-halka B gozune gecirilir; 1.1 mm bosluk 1.0 mm 14K tel tapayla iki uctan dolgusuz alin lazeri, mine maskeli, kaynak noktasi en yakin mineden >=2.5 mm. B'de lehim/kaynak yok. Tas yok.
bench_sequence: CAD: A hilal + ped + C-halka (bosluk 1.1), B disk + goz + Ø4.0 hucre; hucre koseleri r>=0.2; model +0.2 (hucre derinligi bitmis 0.6).
Recine baski -> vakum dokum cinkosuz 14K (Zn sertifikali); B yollugu goz karsisina, A yollugu alt banda.
Tesviye; B hucre tabaninda 10x gozenek kontrolu; hucre temizligi doku birakmadan.
Seri oncesi pilot: ayni alasim + ayni dokumhaneden renk basina kupon, P1-P4 cevrimiyle pisirilir; igne deligi, kabarcik, catlak ve renk tonu gecmeden uretim yok.
Yuzey zenginlestirme (depletion gilding) x3-4: ~593 C -> %10 H2SO4 pickle -> durulama (yalniz mineden ONCE; sonra asit yok).

Islak dolum 1. sarj ince, ICTEN DISA ve renk renk: lacivert gozbebegi Ø1.0 -> buz mavisi bant -> beyaz bant -> dis lacivert bant; her bant ince samur fircayla bir oncekinin kenarina degerek, kuruduktan sonra; bant siniri +-0.1 mm (10x) -> P1 780 C x 1:45 dk.
2. sarj -> P2 780 C x 1:45 dk.
3. sarj (jant ustune hafif tasan) -> P3 780 C x 1:45 dk.
Su altinda alundum tas/elmas pedle mineyi jant kotuna (0-0.05 mm alti) DUZ taslama; hucre kenarinda cip kontrolu.
P4 parlatma pisirimi 770 C x 1:00 dk (toplam 4 pisirim, hepsi <=780 C).
Hafif sitrik pickle + durulama (H2SO4/HNO3 banyo YOK).
A: Stuller 1800 civiyi ped soketine lazer + burgu testi (A firin gormez -> civi sert kalir).
B jant ve arka yuz el cilasi (mine maskeli).
Montaj: C-halkayi B gozune gecir; mineyi Plasti-tac + gumus siperle maskele; 1.0 mm tapayi bosluga oturt, iki ucu dusuk guc alin lazeri; 2 kg cekme testi.
QC: cift 1.69 g +-0.05; mine 10x igne deligi/cip; bant sirasi distan iceri lacivert-beyaz-buz mavisi-lacivert; bant genisligi 0.5 +-0.1; mine jant kotunda veya 0-0.05 mm alti.
bom: Alasim: 14K sari, CINKOSUZ 'enamelable' dokum alasimi (Otto Frei 846-180 no-zinc master alloy ile alasimlanmis; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + DSC solidus), vakum/inert gaz dokum; dokum metali ~1.19 g/cift (govde x 1.15)
Mine: <=780 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon; renk: lacivert, beyaz, buz mavisi (nazar istisnasi: lacivert + beyaz); pisirilmis ~38 mg/cift
2 x Stuller 1800 14KY sert cekme friction civi 0.76 x 11.1 mm (0.0658 g/adet = 0.132 g)
2 x 14K sari friction arkalik 5-6.3 mm (0.25 g/adet VARSAYIM = 0.50 g; KANIT 0.2-0.4 g kaynaksiz - tedarikci numunesi tartilmadan CAD onayi yok)
2 x 1.0 mm sert cekme 14K sari tel tapa, 1.1 mm boy (0.864 mm3 = ~11 mg/adet, ~23 mg/cift; C-halka boslugu, iki uctan dolgusuz alin lazeri)

GRAM DOKUMU (cift, x2 x 0.01307 g/mm3): A hilal (dogrulayici olcumu 9.15 mm2) x 1.0: +9.15 mm3 -> +0.2392 g; A civi pedi O1.6 x 0.3: +0.60 mm3 -> +0.0158 g; A civi soketi: -0.25 mm3 -> -0.0066 g; A dokum C-halka 1.0 kesit ID1.2, bosluk 1.1: +4.20 mm3 -> +0.1098 g; C-halka tapasi 1.0 tel x 1.1: +0.86 mm3 -> +0.0226 g; B nazar diski O5.4 x 1.4: +32.06 mm3 -> +0.8381 g; B tek yuvarlak hucre O4.0 x 0.6 (4 renk bandi): -7.54 mm3 -> -0.1971 g; B jant arka pahi 0.7x0.5: -2.71 mm3 -> -0.0709 g; B dokum kapali goz 1.0 kesit ID1.2: +4.20 mm3 -> +0.1098 g; civi 2 x Stuller 1800 0.76x11.1 = 0.1316 g; arkalik 2 x 0.25 g (varsayim) = 0.50 g => govde 1.0607 g, ALTIN 1.692 g (bant 1.40-1.75, tavana pay 0.058 g)

products.description:
A comet for the ear: a pale ice-blue lab-grown sapphire at the head and three white lab-grown sapphires stepping down along a tapered 14k gold tail. It follows the edge of the ear, makes a bright Christmas gift and wears well every day of the year.

THE PIECE
Each climber is 16.6 mm long and gently curved. The round head is 3.2 mm across and 1.8 mm thick. A bar 2.4 mm to 2.1 mm wide and 1.5 mm thick carries the three white stones, then tapers into a faceted tail 7.8 mm long that ends in a rounded 0.8 mm tip.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.60 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.63 g in total with the stones. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

STONES
Eight lab-grown sapphires in the pair, 0.152 ct in total. Each climber has one 2.0 mm round pale ice-blue sapphire in the head and three round white sapphires of 1.5, 1.4 and 1.3 mm along the bar. Every stone is flush set in its own seat, table level with the gold, over a small hole. The stones are set last, after all polishing.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.6 mm long. The head rests on the lobe with the post behind it, and the tail runs up along the outer edge of the ear. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back. The curve is fixed in the casting; please do not bend the climber, as bending can loosen the flush-set stones.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each climber is cast in 14k gold in one piece with its curve, the tail edges are cut bright, and the post is laser welded, so there is no solder. The stones are set cold, after the last polish, each in its own seat.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth; warm water, mild soap and a soft brush clean the holes behind the stones. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.

products.description:
A small teardrop of ice-blue glass enamel in a polished 14k gold border, hanging point up from a domed gold disc. Clear winter blue for a Christmas gift, and a simple drop that is worn the whole year.

THE PIECE
A domed gold disc 3.4 mm across sits on the lobe. A 1.0 mm gold ring joins it to the teardrop, which is 7.2 mm long, 4.6 mm wide and 1.4 mm thick, with a 0.7 mm polished gold border. Overall length about 12.5 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.69 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.72 g in total with the enamel. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice-blue. The enamel fills the teardrop flat and level with the gold border or just below it. Glass does not fade, but a hard knock can chip it: keep the earrings away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
About 12.5 mm long, sitting just below the lobe; the teardrop moves freely on its ring. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The disc and the teardrop are cast separately in zinc-free 14k gold, and the enamel cell is formed in the casting itself. The enamel is fired four times at no more than 780 C. There is no solder: the post is laser welded to the disc, which never goes into the kiln, and the ring is closed with a laser weld well away from the enamel.

CARE
Store the pair on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

products.description:
A small gold lantern with two arched windows of deep berry glass enamel, framed in polished 14k gold. It brings a warm note to a Christmas gift and stays a cosy everyday stud through winter and beyond.

THE PIECE
Each stud is 5.4 mm wide and 9.9 mm tall: a closed round ring 2.6 mm across on top, a sloped roof with rounded eaves, a square body 4.6 mm wide with two arched windows 1.25 mm wide and 3.1 mm tall, and a flat foot 5.0 mm wide. The plate is 0.85 mm thick, 1.4 mm behind the windows.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.65 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.67 g in total with the enamel. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep berry, a dark raspberry-purple. The enamel fills both windows level with the gold or just below it. Glass does not fade, but a hard knock can chip it: keep the earrings away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
9.9 mm tall. The post sits behind the roof, above the middle of the piece, so the lantern stays upright on the lobe. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each lantern is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece, with the window cells formed in the casting. The enamel is fired four times at 760 C. There is no solder: the hard gold post is laser welded on afterwards, on a pad away from the enamel.

CARE
Store the pair on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.

products.description:
A scarab beetle in 14k gold with its two wing covers in deep jade-green glass enamel. The old amulet of renewal, given as a Christmas gift and worn the whole year.

THE PIECE
Each stud is 5.2 mm wide and 9.3 mm long, gently curved across its width. The head and the plate behind it are polished gold with two lengthwise grooves. The two wing covers are split by a 0.7 mm gold center line inside a 0.7 mm gold border. The shell is 0.9 mm thick, 1.4 mm behind the enamel.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.66 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.70 g in total with the enamel. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep jade-green. The enamel follows the gentle curve of the shell, level with the gold or just below it. Glass does not fade, but a hard knock can chip it: keep the earrings away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
9.3 mm long. The post sits behind the head plate, so the scarab stays upright on the lobe. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each scarab is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece, with the enamel cells formed in the casting. The enamel is fired four times at no more than 780 C. There is no solder: the hard gold post is laser welded on afterwards, on a pad away from the enamel.

CARE
Store the pair on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
products.cold_enamel_paragraph:
ENAMEL
The colour on this piece is hand-applied cold enamel (coloured epoxy resin), not kiln-fired glass: opaque deep jade-green, on the two wing covers. Resin is softer than glass and can scratch with wear. Avoid ultrasonic and steam cleaning and solvents, keep it away from chlorine, and clean it with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

Kilit pedi sag sarkit kokunde, mine kenarina duzlemde 1.55 mm (KANIT >=1.5), pisirim sonrasi lazer. Taslar tum pisirimlerden sonra ayiricilarda, mine kenarina 0.8.
bench_sequence: 1. CAD: bitmis + 0.2; hucre tabani filetosu r0.15; tas pilot delikleri D0.9 modelde (derinlik/cap 1.67); yarik uclari r0.3.
2. Recine baski; besleme bar arkasi ortadan; sarkit uclarina hava kanali.
3. Yatirim + yakma; CINKOSUZ 14K, vakum dokum. Gozenek kontrolu (10x lup, hucre tabanlari); gozenekli parca hurda.
4. Tesviye; bar kalinligi 1.5, hucre derinligi 0.55 derinlik saatiyle; yariklar 0.6 pin-gauge.
5. Hucre temizligi (cam firca, doku yok), tas yuvalarinin on frezesi (mineden ONCE; pisirim sonrasi titresim mineye ulasmasin).
6. Yuzey zenginlestirme: 3-4 dongu ~593 C tav + %10 H2SO4; damitik su, yagsiz.
7. Karsi-mine: gerekmez (taban 0.95 >= 0.8).
8. Islak dolum opak buz mavisi; Pisirim 1: 780 C, 75 sn, kalibre pirometre, sehpada bar alttan destekli.
9. Pisirim 2: ikinci dolum, 780 C, 75 sn.
10. Tasla zimpara (alundum + su), mine altinla es seviye.
11. Pisirim 3: 770 C, 50 sn parlatma. Toplam 3.
12. Asit YOK; bikarbonat + su notr temizlik.
13. Sarkitlarda elmas tiras (mineye torna yaklasmaz; sarkitlar bar altinda).
14. Tas oturtma: 3 x 1.5 lab beyaz safir flush, burnisorle elle (cekic YOK, mine yaninda); mine Plasti-tac ile maskeli.
15. Pisirim sonrasi lazer: sag sarkit kok pedine 460-12 kilit; Plasti-tac + parlak gumus siper, dusuk guc, hava sogutma.
16. Igne 14KW 19.5 mm burgu-sertlestir, sol sarkit kulaklarina percin.
17. Cila (yalniz altin), QC: tartim 3.68 g +/- %5, mine pinhole/catlak 10x, tas testi, kilit 20 ac-kapa.

products.description:
A gold bar with four fields of ice-blue glass enamel and three lab-grown sapphires, and three icicles hanging below it. A winter brooch for Christmas that stays on the coat until spring.

THE PIECE
28 mm wide and 26 mm tall. The bar is 3.9 mm tall; the icicles hang 22, 17 and 15 mm, each with a narrow open slit in its upper half and a rounded tip. Icicle faces are diamond-cut.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.71 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.78 g in total with the enamel and stones.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice blue, level with polished gold borders.

STONES
Three 1.5 mm round lab-grown white sapphires, flush set between the enamel fields. Mohs 9.

HOW IT FASTENS
One pin stem of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING

products.description:
A gold hexagon split by three ribs into three fields of ice-blue glass enamel, with a pale blue lab-grown sapphire where the ribs meet. An ice crystal for the lapel, and a Christmas gift for him.

THE PIECE
18 mm across the corners and 15.6 mm across the flats, 1.45 mm thick, with a 1.0 mm polished gold rim and rounded corners.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.70 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.91 g in total with the enamel and stones.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice blue, level with the gold ribs.

STONES
One 1.5 mm round lab-grown sapphire in a pale ice blue, flush set in the centre disc. Mohs 9.

HOW IT FASTENS
One pin stem of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.

bom: Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Dokum govde (kulak/ped dahil) 3.136 g x 1.15 = 3.61 g dokum metali (yolluk/kayip payi).

products.description:
A scarab for the lapel: a deep jade-green glass enamel shield, ice-blue enamel wing cases and six gold legs. The beetle of renewal and good luck, as a Christmas gift for him.

THE PIECE
22 mm long and 21 mm wide including the legs. A polished 1.0 mm gold ridge runs between the wing cases; the six 1.0 mm legs angle outward with rounded ends.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.91 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 4.00 g in total with the enamel.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque: deep jade green on the front shield, ice blue on the wing cases, level with the gold.

HOW IT FASTENS
One pin stem of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
